authorization_scopes.description: PORT-24 GM1.10C short-press power-on check sub_fc1284ac, caller sub_fc05b962, power-cut sub_fc05ba56, start-cause sub_fc08ecbc, and mode check sub_fc079404 evidence scope (budget: at most 4 KiB per read, 64 KiB total)

evidence_entries.notes: Stock startup creator sub_fc05b962 (0xFC05B962..0xFC05B996) and literals (0xFC05B998..0xFC05B9BF): calls sub_fc05ba68, IsNormalCameraMode_FW (0xFC079404), and power-on check sub_fc1284ac (0xFC1284AC); on zero return, calls sub_fc05ba56 (power cut) and hangs at 0xFC05B976; on non-zero return, calls sub_fc31b460, initializes ARAM heap 0x006CE000 via sub_fc382c8c, and creates task 'Startup' (priority 25) via DryOS CreateTask veneer sub_fc31bbc4

Power-cut function sub_fc05ba56 (0xFC05BA56..0xFC05BA5C) and literal 0xFC05BA64: loads r1 = [0xFC05BA64] = 0x004C0003, loads r0 = 103 (0x67, power-hold GPIO pin), and jumps to GPIO_Write at 0xFC0D73C4, de-asserting the power-hold latch and cutting DC-DC power to the SoC

IsNormalCameraMode_FW (0xFC079404..0xFC079410) and literal pool at 0xFC0794B0 (0xFDF20380): loads byte from ROM address 0xFDF20380; if byte is 0 returns 1 (normal camera mode), otherwise returns 0; return value is passed in r0 to sub_fc1284ac to govern button-hold supervision check
ROM flag byte at 0xFDF20380 read by IsNormalCameraMode_FW: first byte is 0x00, confirming that IsNormalCameraMode_FW returns 1 in default firmware state

sub_fc08ecbc start-cause recorder (0xFC08ECBC..0xFC08ECEC) called by sub_fc1284ac at 0xFC128510: loads base pointer from literal at 0xFC08EEF0 (0x00009BC4); writes startup reason word at offset +12: 0x80000 for Power button, 0x100000 for Playback button, 0x40000 for WiFi button, 0x20000 for GPIO 2
Literal pool for sub_fc08ecbc: word at 0xFC08EEF0 contains 0x00009BC4, proving that RAM address 0x9BC4 is the startup-cause structure base on GM1.10C, matching historical sister-port G3 X 1.10E
GPIO_Write at 0xFC0D73C4 (computes MMIO 0xD20B0800 + pin*4, so pin 0x67 writes to 0xD20B099C) and GPIO_Read at 0xFC0D73D0 (reads MMIO 0xD20B0800 + pin*4)

Stock power-on button check sub_fc1284ac (0xFC1284AC..0xFC12851A): takes IsNormalCameraMode_FW in r0; samples GPIO 0x97 (Power button, 0xFC1284BC), GPIO 0x98 (Playback button, 0xFC1284C8), GPIO 0x88 (WiFi button, 0xFC1284DA), and GPIO 0x02 (0xFC1284EC); if in normal mode (sl != 0) and all button states are unasserted (0), branches to 0xFC12851A returning 0, triggering shutdown via sub_fc05ba56; if any button is pressed or mode is non-normal, calls sub_fc08ecbc and returns 1 at 0xFC128518
